videos.headline: Smith to Jack Leach, out Caught by Warner!! SCG errupts and it's their local boy Steve Smithy Warne who rips one off the turf and gets Leach poking just outside off, a thick outside edge and another Sydney boy takes the catch at slip. Warner grabs it and tosses the ball into the air before being mobbed by his team mates. Look at the energy in the Aussie camp. They are jumping, hollering and hugging......and what not. In fact top grab by Davey. The ball deflected off Carey's left hand but he kept his eyes on the ball. Jack Leach c Warner b Smith 26(34) [4s-2]

Boland to Bairstow, out Caught by Labuschagne!! There's the wicket and Australia go bonkers..... Bairstow just hung his head down and walked. Didn't even bother to see who took the catch. Absolute shocker. Snaking in from a good length just outside off, Bairstow looked to defend in front of his body and got a thick inside edge onto pad that lobbed straight to Labuschagne at silly point. Cummins is cock-a-hoop and so are rest of his mates... Australia, 2 wickets away.... Bairstow c Labuschagne b Boland 41(105) [4s-3]

Cummins to Mark Wood, out Lbw!! Patty Cummins you beauty. The captain turning the game in this over. Unplayable inswinging toe-crusher. Proper shoe smasher that. Wood had the bat down but no way he could have countered that late big swing. What control and direction under pressure from Cummins. Hits the left boot in line with middle and Wood is down immediately in pain. Umpire Paul Reiffel raised the finger and Cummins runs off in his celebration. Teammates mob him. Ball tracking says hitting leg stump. Mark Wood lbw b Cummins 0(2)

Cummins to Buttler, out Lbw!! What a moment in the game. So this was a full delivery shaping back in late, Buttler looks to play straight but the bottom of the bat flicked the front pad before the ball came and that meant the bat faced turned to open up a gap for the ball to sneak through and hit the back leg. Unlucky for Buttler. Played the right line but that obstruction led to his downfall. It was a huge appeal for LBW. Ump Reiffel heard that noise off the bat, so he thought it was inside edge, but it was bat hitting pad and DRS helping Australia. Do they still believe they can win? And the sun comes out too. 4 wickets to go. Buttler lbw b Cummins 11(38)

Lyon to Stokes, out Caught by Smith!! Edged and taken at first slip. Oh Stokes is gutted. He's so gutted. He wants to slam the bat into the ground and break it into the pieces. Holds his bat high in disbelief and then walks off placing it behind the neck. He wanted to see this through. It's that extra bounce that does the trick for Lyon. Pitching close to off and bouncing with turn, just a bit of poke on the defence and straight to Smith. Australia get the wicket they were after. Over to Jos Buttler! Stokes c Smith b Lyon 60(123) [4s-10 6s-1]

Boland to Root, out Caught by Carey!! He's found the nick! Just unrelenting accuracy from Boland, putting it there ball after ball and getting the odd one to move off the seam. This one's on the fuller side of a length just outside off, draws Root forward in defence and straightens to take a feather through to Carey. Australia have the breakthrough they were after. Root c Carey b Boland 24(85) [4s-3]

Green to Crawley, out Lbw!! Smart from Cameron Green. He knew Crawley was looking positive and trying to score more often than not. Also he was feasting on anything full and short with nimble footwork across his off-stump. Pinged in a 133ks inswinging yorker and caught Crawley by surprise, by the time the bat came down he knew he was a dead duck. Was struck in front of off and it seemed heading towards middle and leg real time. Crawley had a long chat with his skipper and went up for the review, more in hope. Walks back in frustration having played so well this morning. Crawley lbw b Green 77(100) [4s-13]

Lyon to Malan, out Bowled!! This is irresponsible batting from Malan and the coaches won't be happy. A. No feet movement B. Not trying to cover the line C. Exposing the sticks and playing away from the body. Simple slider from Lyon. But it's very effective when the batters are lazy to move their feet. Not a ball to be playing off the back foot. Tries to cut late, misses and the ball hits the not even the top off stump, almost middle of off stump. Malan b Lyon 4(29)

Boland to Haseeb Hameed, out Caught by Carey!! This is the problem of just block, block, block to the moving ball. Carey feels better with that collect. Hameed isn't one to press that front foot nicely forward. He just has a small step, which means he is allowing the ball to deviate more and that also means he will find it tougher to negotiate the moving ball. Boland got this length delivery to leave the right-hander with bounce and pinned him on the crease by bowling tight around off stump. Thick edge, Carey went with both hands this time. Australia have the early wicket. Haseeb Hameed c Carey b Boland 9(58)

Jack Leach to Smith, out Bowled!! Jack you beauty Leachy! He's got this to skid off the surface and stun Smith on the back foot. Smith looks at the pitch is disbelief. Was the slider to which Smith went back to push through the off-side, was late on the shot as the ball came quicker than he expected. Hits middle and off. Key wicket as Smith was looking set to change gears. Smith b Jack Leach 23(31) [4s-2 6s-1]

Mark Wood to Labuschagne, out Caught by (sub)Ollie Pope!! Oh appeal. Guilty look from Marnus. Given! Third catch for keeper Pope. This was a shortish delivery outside off stump, Labuschagne thought he had the width to cut. Sure was, but it jumped extra than he anticipated and forced him to push at the ball. Thin edge, which was heard by the men who mattered. Brilliant start to the session for England. Labuschagne c (sub)Ollie Pope b Mark Wood 29(42) [4s-1]

Jack Leach to Marcus Harris, out Caught by (sub)Ollie Pope!! Marcus Harris was getting frustrated with the string of dots and was perhaps looking for a release shot against the spinner. Saw the loop and width outside off, was all hands on the drive as he leant into it with hard hands, the ball drifts in nicely and takes the faintest of outside edges through to the keeper. Pope did well to stay low and collect that. Knew Harris got a nick and celebrated straightaway. Marcus Harris c (sub)Ollie Pope b Jack Leach 27(61) [4s-3]

Mark Wood to Warner, out Caught by (sub)Ollie Pope!! Oh noooooo," was the exact reaction from Warner soon as it left the bat. Tosses his bat in the air and turns back in frustration. Was a perfect teaser in the outside off corridor, slanting away from a length, Warner poked with hard hands and Pope takes the simplest of catches behind the stumps. Warner c (sub)Ollie Pope b Mark Wood 3(18)

Boland to Bairstow, out Caught by Carey!! Bairstow has been a spectator the last few deliveries and perhaps lost his concentration a bit? Tries to dab the short of length delivery down to third man but there's still ample seam movemet which snicks a fine outside edge before landing in the mitts of the keeper. A fantastic knock comes to an end and Bairstow gets a warm round of applause from the SCG crowd as he strolls back to the pavilion. Bairstow c Carey b Boland 113(158) [4s-8 6s-3]

Lyon to Jack Leach, out Caught by Cummins!! There's the first wicket of the day and it didn't long.... Lyon threw it full and wide of off-stump, lured Leach into a slog sweep and got the top-edge. Cummins runs to his left at mid-wicket and accepts it gleefully. Jack Leach c Cummins b Lyon 10(29) [4s-2]

Cummins to Mark Wood, out Caught by Lyon!! Cummins banged it short and gave no room for Wood on the off-side, he looked to go for the pull and seemed to have got the faintest of top-edges that delfects off the helmet straight to Lyon at backward point. The review was taken almost at the last second and no-one really looked confident on the field. Wood looks befuddled as he makes the long walk back to the pavilion. Has been an entertaining knock from the Durham lad. Mark Wood c Lyon b Cummins 39(41) [4s-2 6s-3]

Cummins to Buttler, out Caught by Khawaja!! Buttler's gone pushing well in front of the body. It's a fuller length just outside off, Buttler looks to flick and it goes off a leading edge to cover. Stopped on him a touch perhaps. Good low catch by Khawaja there to give Cummins his first wicket. Buttler c Khawaja b Cummins 0(8)

Lyon to Stokes, out Lbw!! Oh that's out! Stokes turns around and walks off even without waiting for the decision. Skidding through off a length from round the wicket, Stokes is right back in the crease and misses as he plays across the line. Was just surprised by how quickly it came off the pitch. He's struck on the pad in front of middle and that is just plumb. Lyon's taken some punishment but he breaks this partnership. Stokes lbw b Lyon 66(91) [4s-9 6s-1]

Green to Malan, out Caught by Khawaja!! Off the glove and taken at leg slip. What a field placement this from Australia. Green gets the deserved wicket in this spell. He smashed Malan on the glove twice in the over before. So Malan was so worried in his back foot defence. There's Uz Khawaja staring at him at leg slip. So anything short and at the ribs is uncomfortable. Malan fends in hope, but the fielder was perfectly placed fine enough for it to carry off the glove. Khawaja stays low and completes the catch to make it 36/4. Off they go for a tasty lunch! Malan c Khawaja b Green 3(39)

Boland to Root, out Caught by Smith!! Edgeddd and a brilliant grab overhead at second slip. That edge was flying to the boundary. Short of a length delivery outside off stump, Root chases that wide ball and looks to power it through cover-point, but gets a thick edge. And this is very interesting. Root almost started walking even before the catch was completed because he knew he didn't deserve to stay there after that shot. Oh England! Why England! It's happening all over again. This series, it has got their best batter too. You could hardly see the pressure of the team in the captain's batting. Root comes out and usually plays like there's no weight on him. But he's had low ones here. That's what an Ashes series can do! Root c Smith b Boland 0(7)

Boland to Crawley, out Bowled!! This is a top nut. Crawley plays an aggressive drive and was beaten by the ball that cut back in sharply. Hitting top of off stump is an art and getting it to seam back in after drawing the batter forward and beating his attempted full-fledged drive is a special feeling for a bowler. Crawley was taking an off stump guard all day. He was standing just outside the crease too. These two factors would have given him the confidence that okay, I have covered the line so it's safe to play the straight drive. But that aggressive drive meant the ball gets a gap to sneak through and Boland landed in the perfect spot to convince the batter into the drive for four and then cunningly get that seam movement. Sure would sped to the boundary if didn't. He looked so assured at the crease but one bit of rashness brings his downfall. Crawley b Boland 18(55) [4s-2]

Starc to Haseeb Hameed, out Bowled!! The problem of that front foot going nowhere. Did they put some cement on the crease! Horrible on the replay to see the ball crash through the gate. A bus could have gone through that bat-pad gap. So it was a full delivery pitching around middle and off. Hameed tried the straight drive, bat came down straight. That's fine but that front foot didn't move an inch and it's not even an exaggeration. Was literally a sitting duck with Starc steaming in. Most balls were angled away so Hameed played that line, which meant he left a massive gap for this nip-backer to hit not off stump but middle stump. Yes middle stump! Haseeb Hameed b Starc 6(26) [4s-1]

Broad to Khawaja, out Bowled!! Broad has a five-for. How badly he needed that. His 19th in Test cricket and 6th against Australia, also the first for England this series. Bowls it on a good length around the sixth stump channel and lures Khawaja into a lazy poke. All hands, no feet. Result? A thick inside edge that clatters back onto middle and off. End of a terrific knock from the comeback man and he walks off to a rousing reception from the crowd. Khawaja b Broad 137(260) [4s-13]

Broad to Cummins, out Caught by Buttler!! England celebrate but the umpire is unmoved. Did that take something to the keeper? A sharp bouncer from Broad, has Cummins hopping on the crease and he takes his eyes off as the ball gets quite big on him. There's a bit of glove on the way, or maybe the top of the handle, and a big spike shows up on UltraEdge. So the decision will be overturned. Broad gets his fourth. Cummins c Buttler b Broad 24(47) [4s-4]

Root to Carey, out Caught by Bairstow!! Bairstow ain't dropping that. He's done enough wicket-keeping to grab this tricky swirlers - if one may call it that. Carey decided to slog over mid-wicket and got a thick top-edge that looped up backwards of mid-wicket to his right. YJB kept his eyes on the ball, ran back and completed the catch with a slide across the turf. Carey c Bairstow b Root 13(39) [4s-2]

Broad to Green, out Caught by Crawley!! Lunging and defending against seam bowling isn't going to work. It's a thick edge this time thanks to hard hands and comfortably carrying to third slip. Was being troubled on both edges. Tries to push away from the body and nicks off. England look like England since new ball. Green c Crawley b Broad 5(14) [4s-1]

Broad to Smith, out Caught by Buttler!! He's got him Broady. What an over. Troubled Smith all over and eventually finds the outside edge. Back of a length into the wicket and seaming away, Smith moves across and opened up in his defence by the away movement. Nick off and Buttler collects to his right. Important wicket for England. Smith was looking good for a big innings. Finally something to cheer today for England. Smith c Buttler b Broad 67(141) [4s-5]

Mark Wood to Labuschagne, out Caught by Buttler!! Oh England have struck back to back! And again there's something off the seam to take the edge. Wood goes wide of the crease, angles it in around off on back of a length, and the ball straightens just a touch with Labuschagne looking to defend from the crease. Labuschagne c Buttler b Mark Wood 28(59) [4s-4]

Anderson to Marcus Harris, out Caught by Root!! Anderson strikes! It's a pretty good delivery this. Good length delivery pitching middle and leaving off with the angle, Harris tries to defend from the crease but his back foot hasn't gone across much. It takes the edge and carries nicely to first slip where Root makes no mistake. Marcus Harris c Root b Anderson 38(109) [4s-4]

Anderson to Marcus Harris, out Caught by Root!! Anderson strikes! It's a pretty good delivery this. Good length delivery pitching middle and leaving off with the angle, Harris tries to defend from the crease but his back foot hasn't gone across much. It takes the edge and carries nicely to first slip where Root makes no mistake. Marcus Harris c Root b Anderson 38(109) [4s-4]

Anderson to Marcus Harris, out Caught by Root!! Anderson strikes! It's a pretty good delivery this. Good length delivery pitching middle and leaving off with the angle, Harris tries to defend from the crease but his back foot hasn't gone across much. It takes the edge and carries nicely to first slip where Root makes no mistake. Marcus Harris c Root b Anderson 38(109) [4s-4]

Broad to Warner, out Caught by Crawley!! Broad has Warner! Back into the attack and strikes straightaway. Full ball just outside off, tempts him into the drive and the ball nips away just a touch to take the edge to second slip. Went at around chest height to Crawley who cups it to his right. England break through. Warner c Crawley b Broad 30(72) [4s-6]
